provenance: synthetic_demo_fixture: invented site, zones, shifts and task schedule for the Cocoon backend demo. Not dataset data, not a real site, not a calibrated plan. Task types and work units follow Cocoon_Dataset_v1 task_history for each machine category.

units.work_quantity: per task work_unit: m3 (cubic metres), m (metres), m2 (square metres), t (tonnes), t_km (tonne-kilometres)
units.duration_minutes: minutes; a supplied demo estimate, NOT a calibrated prediction (estimator is Batch C)
units.times: shift and task times are site-local wall-clock offsets, stored as UTC after seeding for the chosen service date

tasks.title: Excavate the north pit bench
tasks.details: Dig the marked bench in the north pit to grade stakes and load spoil to the truck.

tasks.title: Open the east drainage trench
tasks.details: Trench along the east drainage line to the marked depth; keep spoil one metre back from the edge.

tasks.title: Break out the old culvert headwall
tasks.details: Remove the old concrete headwall with the breaker and stockpile the rubble.

tasks.title: Grade the access road strip
tasks.details: Grade the access road strip to the survey stakes.

tasks.title: Push up the stockpile
tasks.details: Push loose material into the stockpile footprint.

tasks.title: Load trucks from the stockpile
tasks.details: Load the haul trucks from the stockpile face.

tasks.title: Rebuild the stockpile face
tasks.details: Tidy and rebuild the stockpile face after loading.

tasks.title: Haul spoil to the crusher
tasks.details: Haul loaded spoil from the north pit to the crusher.

tasks.title: Dig the cable trench
tasks.details: Dig the cable trench to the marked depth.

tasks.title: Backfill the cable trench
tasks.details: Backfill and compact the cable trench after inspection.
